name: Shishunki ~And I Love Her~
source:
Hero entered urban art vocational school to become a painter. He is given a task to draw "Adolescence", but he has no ideas about it. His classmate advised him to draw "love", but to draw love hero needs first to know love, so goes looking for girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation: 主人公进入了城市艺术职业学校，想成为一名画家。他被布置了一项画"青春期"的作业，但他毫无头绪。同学建议他画"爱情"，但要画爱情，主人公需要先了解爱情，于是他开始寻找女孩们。
